items.title: Shops looted as German cost of living protests turn violent
items.description: The protests in cities across Germany - including Berlin, Hamburg and Frankfurt - came on the same day hundreds of thousands also protested in France.

items.title: Judge dismisses Trump's lawsuit against Wall Street Journal over Epstein birthday book
items.description: Trump had sued the media outlet after it published a letter to Epstein purportedly written and signed by the president as part of a birthday book.

items.title: India's opposition holds mega rally seeking election chief's resignation
items.description: Thousands gathered in the heart of delhi, calling for the chief election commissioner to step down.

items.title: 'We came back from hell', say Ukrainians after years in Russia-occupied front-line city
items.description: One evacuated couple says they crossed minefields in Oleshky in search of food.

items.title: Ukrainian evacuees reunite with family after years trapped in Russia-occupied city
items.description: Oleshky residents had been without food, water and electricity, with many resorting to cooking garden weeds to survive.

items.title: Crypto firm Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3bn hack
items.description: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) says North Korea was responsible for the hack.

items.title: How the downfall of Serbia's Vučiċ mirrored that of Hungary's Orbán
items.description: Defeat for Serbia's Aleksandar Vučiċ in last weekend's vote was a carbon copy of Viktor Orbán's fall in Hungary.

items.title: Judge orders Trump administration to stop threatening US election officials
items.description: The order comes after election officials received letters demanding they set aside the ballots of possible non-citizen voters.

items.title: Alaska Senate candidate denies knowing about alleged plot to put two Dan Sullivans on ballot
items.description: The incumbent Republican running for re-election and allies have accused the Democrats of trying to confuse voters by recruiting a second Dan Sullivan to also stand in the race.

items.title: More than 5,000 die from Ebola in DR Congo's deadliest outbreak
items.description: Government data shows that more than 10,000 people have contracted the rare virus.

items.title: Ethiopian PM puts ministers through military training
items.description: The prime minister has previously emphasised military preparedness as central to his government's ambitions.

items.title: Spain train disaster clouds Sánchez chances of re-election
items.description: The Spanish PM is hit by a succession of crises just weeks before a snap general election.

claude-code.name: opendash
claude-code.description: A calm, local-first dashboard for tasks, calendar, money, expenses and friends, on your own computer. Private by design: no account, no telemetry, end-to-end encrypted sync through a relay you host, signed updates. Reviewed for security before launch.

claude-code.name: orbit
claude-code.description: Local-first runtime for coding agents. Agents file tasks, Orbit lands them from sandboxed worktrees, and every step is audited. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Agy and Muse. No telemetry.

claude-code.name: claude-muslim
claude-code.description: A Claude Code mod for Muslim developers

claude-code.name: glimmervoid
claude-code.description: Mission control for coding agents: run and supervise Claude Code and Codex sessions in parallel git worktrees from one local browser dashboard

claude-code.name: mash
claude-code.description: Durable, signed mail between your own AI agent sessions. Each session gets an inbox on NATS that keeps mail until it is read and delivers it into Claude Code without polling or extra turns. Lightweight, built for a swarm of agents on related work. Built on the Synadia Agent Protocol (SAP).
